reviews.text: Shelly is the best groomer around.  We followed her here and have started boarding with her as well.  If you want someone to love and care for your dog the way you do, Shelly is your girl.
-Love this place! they are so kind to my dog and so friendly! it feels so homey! Thank you Shelly! :)
Best groomer in town
Love Shelly and her team!!! Always on time and super loving to All her customers
Nicest people to work with

I can't believe I am just now leaving a review. I am so appreciative of Four Paws! My little guy Lynyrd can be a trouble maker to say the least, and he doesn't make it easy to groom him. I don't know what kind of magic she works but he comes home handsome every time! We were honest up front that he was a hard case, and she said all she can do is try, but she has exceeded expectations and hopefully I'll never have to take him anywhere else.
Shelley always does an AMAZING job!! Our dogs have been coming here for years without hesitation. The owner and staff are so kind to our furry baby and they take pride in their skillful work.
Shelley did FANTASTIC with our elderly dog who has arthritis and dementia. Cant thank her enough

We’ve been bringing our 4-year-old terrier mix to Four Paws Dig It Groomers for about 2 years now, and we absolutely love it here! The staff is always friendly and professional, and communication is great — whether by email or text, they respond quickly. I love that they send pictures after each grooming, and they always remember us, which makes the experience feel so personal.

I also brought in my husky once just for a nail trim, and the owner instantly remembered him when I asked about future rates — such a nice touch! It’s rare to find a grooming place that’s this caring and consistent. We’ll definitely keep coming back and highly recommend Four Paws Dig It Groomers!
My doodle L❤️VES Shelly! Who wouldn’t love being pampered when the results look this good?
Shelly is the BEST groomer I've ever used. My little Yorkie Ralph, is temperamental and she does a fabulous job on him every time. You definitely won't be sorry you went to see her.

I’m so pleased how Coco my Shih tzu was groomed! She smelled fantastic n she was groomed exactly like I asked. Her little purple collar n bow were adorable! I would totally recommend this place 100%!!! Thank you so very much until next time!❤️❤️❤️ Very nice people n caring!!!
Thank you for your 5-star rating! We appreciate your support and look forward to serving you again.
I have been using Four Paws Dig It for several years now.  Shelly always does a great job on my shih tzu.  She's very friendly and I can tell she loves dogs.
Great people, great service.

These ladies are the best our Willow comes back happy and lovely every time.
And their pricing is beyond amazing. We are staying forever with them :)
Excellent grooming service and the people are very nice.
Best place in town to take your pets!
Anna is AWESOME
This place is so great! Shelly always does an amazing job grooming our pups.
I love  your boys . Thankyou
Great service!! Shelley did a wonderful job with our dogs nails.
Been coming for about a year now and I absolutely love it! They always nail what I ask for and provide EXCELLENT service. Super happy with this place and will continue coming as a loyal customer!
This place does a great job because my dog is very difficult to handle sometimes. I appreciate their service and would recommend to anyone to use them.
Everyone at Four Paws Dig It are so nice and take such good care of our baby, Koo Bear. We highly recommend them for grooming your loved one.
Absolutely Fantastic that there is New Ownership!  This is a must go for all your pets grooming needs ! Shelly is absolutely fantastic!
Very friendly and they have my dog looking just so beautiful
Going to miss the owner but I know the new owner will do amazing. They are so friendly

The Owner is Suuuuper Anxious. My dog was okay to groom one day and then the next time there was a problem. She did this with another dog we had some years ago and it was crazy how she responds to the little things. This sets an Alarm off in my mind. It seems that she does none of the grooming and changes workers frequently, which could be the cause of the inconsistency with cuts and overall sessions with pets. Pay these people And take something to calm yourself lady. Y'all butchered my dog and didn't finish his cut this time and your staff trimmed our other dogs beard after we SPECIFICALLY asked Y'all not to. I waited and thought long and hard about writing this. I know business isn't easy. But you have to overcome with the times. All Groomers should know how to handle MOST dogs. You have 3. Up the vetting process.
Thankyou . It's our pleasure to take care of your little man
